rows.en: Braaavooo! Mister Brain!! That… that idiot One-Eight! He's shown up!
DON'T ATTACK, HAKEN KILLER! ONE-EIGHT IS BRAIN'S ROBOT!
I knew it… One-Eight is hopeless!
ONE-EIGHT! WE ARE BROTHERS! WE ARE ON THE SAME SIDE!
One-Eight, that's dirty! How could you do that!?
Look! The Brain robot put something like a "crown" on One-Seven's head!

OH, WHAT AMAZING POWER!

BUT… IT'S A LITTLE CROOKED, ISN'T IT? IT MUST NOT FALL OFF…

IS THIS ALL RIGHT…?
I don't know… He suddenly couldn't move!
Hmm… It's probably an electromagnetic filter… That "crown"-like thing is it.
THE REST IS YOURS, WITH MISSILES…

The only way to revive One-Seven is to remove the electromagnetic filter!

But… One-Seven took a barrage of missiles and is buried underground… digging him out may be impossible for us.
Leave this to us! Everyone, evacuate quickly… Saburo, please!
Leave this to us! Everyone, get out of here quick… Saburo, I'm counting on you!
Understood! Rumi, Yazaki… come on, this way!

Yes…

It's just about to start.

Seriously? Talk about super late…

To make up for it… you're gonna have to work extra hard.

…!?

Something exploded underground where One-Seven went down!!
Don't tell me!? Was that "crown" a time bomb?
It's no exaggeration to say… he's been completely destroyed.

Look… the "crown" has come off! The electromagnetic filter exploded!

The time bomb was meant to destroy the "crown"…
But… who on earth planted it?
It's no good! The Brain robot moves too fast!
One shot… that's all we've got! One-Seven, fire!

…!?

THIS IS THE CHANCE I WAS WAITING FOR!

MY REACTOR IS HIT… I WILL EXPLODE SOON!

FAREWELL, BROTHER… FAREWELL, ISAMU…!
One-Eight… was only pretending to betray us, wasn't he?
To land that one-shot Graviton, the enemy had to be caught off guard…
One-Eight… was only pretending to betray us…
Now that I think about it… the one who put the time bomb on the electromagnetic filter must have been…
One-Eight sacrificed himself to defeat the assassin robot Haken Killer! His feelings pierced the heart of his brother One-Seven and his best friend Yazaki…
We will not let those feelings go to waste! At his beloved brother's grave marker, One-Seven vowed a decisive battle against Brain…

Yes!

He says he wants you to come, Doctor!
He says it has to be you, Doctor.
Isn't that right in the middle of Tokyo?
There's a big, dark cave underground…

Could it be… the secret factory the old Japanese army dug during World War II!?

Did he choose it to slip past Brain's eyes?
The repairs are almost finished, aren't they?

uncertain: U14342-U14393: robot katakana speech in capitals, as in previous batches.
U14351: One-Seven seems to think One-Eight has come around just before being tricked; kept as a question.
U14361: One-Eight tells the Brain robot to finish One-Seven with missiles (part of his act).
U14373: casual heroine variant teasing [HERO2] for arriving late.
U14383: お前って奴は (admiring) rendered 'You really are something'.
U14355/U14360/U14375/U14380: ［王冠］ brackets changed to double quotes.
omissions_kept: U14401: the source trails off before naming One-Eight; kept unfinished ('must have been…').
